name: io.github.Serdnaley/metabase-mcp
title: Metabase MCP (headless)
description: Headless Metabase MCP: API-key auth, no OAuth. 178 tools, toolsets, stdio or HTTP, all tiers.

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Metabase API key (or set METABASE_EMAIL + METABASE_PASSWORD)

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Login email (alternative to an API key)

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Login password (alternative to an API key)

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of toolsets or presets (all, query, content, admin)

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_TOOLS_ENABLE
environmentVariables.description: Extra tools to enable (names or globs)

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_TOOLS_DISABLE
environmentVariables.description: Tools to disable (names or globs); always wins

environmentVariables.name: METABASE_CUSTOM_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Extra headers for every Metabase request (e.g. Cloudflare Access)
